## 更新内容 / Changes

- 修复 Claude Code 将可确认的最新分叉会话误判为不可继续的问题。只有 transcript 文件名对应最后一个且未重现的会话 ID、来源与快照校验通过时，才允许从该 ID 创建新对话分叉。若当前分叉的原生 `parentUuid` 链连接到较早记录，官方 CLI 会带入可达的祖先上下文，预览会明确提示。较早 ID、ID 顺序不明确或文件名不符、记录不完整或已变化、工作目录身份变化仍禁止恢复；管理器不会改写原会话文件。
- Fixed a false resume block for a safely identifiable latest Claude Code fork in a mixed-ID transcript. Resume is enabled only when the transcript filename matches the final, non-reappearing session ID and source / snapshot checks pass. If its native `parentUuid` chain reaches an earlier record, the official CLI includes reachable ancestor context and the preview explains this. Older IDs, ambiguous ordering or filename mismatches, incomplete or changed transcripts, and changed working-directory identities remain ineligible. The manager does not rewrite the original transcript.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP，附件包含 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。运行实例、账号、会话与本地配置会继续保留；安装更新前请等待运行中的实例和管理器完全退出。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。Windows、Linux 和其他架构尚未完成验证。

DMG and ZIP packages are available for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Running instances, accounts, sessions and local settings are retained; wait until active instances and the manager have exited before installing an update. In-app updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included. Windows, Linux and other architectures have not been validated.

## 客户端支持 / Client support

此修复适用于 macOS 官方原生 Claude Code CLI 的本地会话浏览及受管实例恢复。Claude Desktop、默认目录和本地 Desktop Code 记录仍只读；混合 ID 文件的安全判定适用于当前验证的 CLI 会话格式。

This fix applies to local session browsing and managed-instance resume in the official native Claude Code CLI for macOS. Claude Desktop, the default directory and locally saved Desktop Code transcripts remain read-only. Mixed-ID eligibility applies to the currently verified CLI transcript format.

## 验证来源 / Verification

使用 Claude CLI 2.1.295 与隔离配置目录和本地模拟 Messages 服务验证混合 ID 分叉的 `--resume` 行为、原生 `parentUuid` 祖先上下文、旧 ID 拒绝及工作目录边界；测试使用合成 transcript 与凭据，没有连接真实付费上游。

Mixed-ID `--resume` behavior, native `parentUuid` ancestor context, rejection of older IDs and working-directory boundaries were verified with Claude CLI 2.1.295, an isolated configuration and a local mock Messages service. Tests use synthetic transcripts and credentials and do not connect to a paid upstream service.
